pipeline_json.name: pharmacy_silver_ods
pipeline_json.description: Silver raw to silver ODS v2 — hash CDC (INSERT/UPDATE/NOOP), ods_record_hash includes is_active, merge on natural keys without source_system, deduped patients join, no DELETE writer.

  SELECT
    r.*,
    sha2(concat_ws('||',
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.is_active as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.claim_type as string)), ''),

      coalesce(trim(cast(r.admission_date as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.discharge_date as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.statement_from as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.statement_through as string)), ''),

      coalesce(trim(cast(r.admission_source as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.discharge_status as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.claim_adjustment_type_cd as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.claim_status as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.reason_for_visit as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.actual_length_of_stay as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.covered_length_of_stay as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.line_of_business as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.product as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.primary_payer as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.clm_type_cd as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.clm_op_srvc_type_cd as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.dgns_prcdr_icd_ind as string)), ''),
      coalesce(trim(cast(r.clm_prcsg_ind_cd as string)), ''),

        ORDER BY try_cast(p.batch_id AS bigint) DESC, coalesce(p.updated_at, p.created_at) DESC

  FROM raw_batch r

  SELECT

    e.created_by, e.created_at, e.updated_by, e.updated_at, e.source_system,
    e.source_claim_id, e.claim_type, e.source_resource_id, e.source_resource_type, e.source_format,
    e.patient_id, e.source_billing_org_id, e.source_rendering_org_id,
    e.admission_date, e.discharge_date, e.statement_from, e.statement_through, e.paid_date,
    e.claim_effective_date, e.claim_received_date, e.claim_version_num, e.adjusted_claim_id,
    e.drg_code, coalesce(o.drg_code_desc, e.drg_code_desc) AS drg_code_desc, e.drg_code_system,
    e.bill_type, e.admission_type, e.admission_source, e.discharge_status,
    e.claim_adjustment_type_cd, e.claim_status, e.reason_for_visit,
    e.actual_length_of_stay, e.covered_length_of_stay, e.line_of_business, e.product, e.primary_payer,
    e.clm_type_cd, e.clm_op_srvc_type_cd, e.dgns_prcdr_icd_ind, e.clm_prcsg_ind_cd,

    coalesce(o.patient_sid, e.patient_sid) AS patient_sid,
    CASE

      ELSE 'NOOP'

    SELECT o.*,

        PARTITION BY o.source_claim_id
        ORDER BY try_cast(o.batch_id AS bigint) DESC, coalesce(o.updated_at, o.created_at) DESC
      ) AS dup_seq
    FROM ${catalog}.${ods_schema}.claims_header o
  ) o
    ON o.source_claim_id = e.source_claim_id
   AND o.dup_seq = 1
)
SELECT * FROM with_ods WHERE cdc_action <> 'NOOP'
) x WHERE cdc_action = 'INSERT'
